Marin Lopez: Hey all! Im Marin, joining the infra team today. Lover of terrible puns, ramen, and low-maintenance succulents. Mostly remote (SEA) but visiting SF next week. Any recs for lunch near the office? :wave:
Sam Pizza: Welcome Marin!! Ramen: Slurp Station 3 blocks away. Parking is tight but theres a bike rack by the east entrance if you pedal. :ramen:
Becky Chen: Welcome!! We do a casual lunch crawl Tue afternoons if you want to tag along. Also we have a succulent shelf in the kitchen you can add to.
Marin Lopez: Succulent shelf?? Yes. Name suggestion poll: "Captain Spike" vs "Leafy McLeaf" :seedling:
Rafa: Captain Spike wins, obviously. Also FYI badge will be at security after 9:30.
welcome-bot: Reminder: Please finish your benefits enrollment in 5 days: https://redwood.example/benefits
Sam Pizza: Also tiny heads-up: we keep a stash of instant miso in the pantry for late-night deploys.
Marin Lopez: Perfect. Ill bring a little pot for the shelf tomorrow. Thanks for the warm welcome! :sparkles:
